Damian "daps" Steele (born July 28, 1993) is a Canadian professional Counter-Strike 2 coach and former player and a former professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player and coach of Argentine descent. He is known for his time with a number of top North American teams such as Team Liquid, OpTic Gaming, NRG Esports, Cloud9, and Gen.G Esports. He initially retired in October 2020 to pursue a career in VALORANT, before returning eight months later as a coach.
